news.title: Mhada gets three land parcels in Nashik to help build homes for about 200 families
news.para: Maharashtra Housing Authority received surplus land for affordable housing. This land will accommodate nearly two hundred lower-income families in Nashik. The district administration transferred the land at a nominal rate of one rupee. Mhada must initiate the housing project within three years of possession. This initiative aims to boost affordable housing options for many residents.

news.title: Hingoli to mandate earthquake-resistant homes, including those under PMAY, in seismic zones
news.para: Hingoli district will mandate earthquake-resistant construction for all new homes. This includes houses built under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana scheme. The administration seeks technical guidance from CBRI for building norms. Local masons and construction workers are receiving training in new techniques. Existing homeowners will also be encouraged to retrofit their properties.

news.title: New Noida land acquisition begins in August, 40% area earmarked for industries
news.para: Noida Authority begins land acquisition for New Noida in August.  Lekhpals will survey 37 villages for the initial phase.  The project aims to ease urbanisation pressure and boost economic activity.  Infrastructure development will follow land acquisition and plot allotment.  New Noida is planned as a smart city and industrial hub.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh did not seek PMAY-U 2.0 houses for Amaravati: Centre
news.para: The Union government informed Parliament that Andhra Pradesh did not request housing under PMAY-U 2.0 for Amaravati.  The state submitted proposals for other urban local bodies, receiving approval for many houses.  Central assistance has been released for sanctioned houses, exceeding the maximum eligibility.  The original PMAY-U scheme in Andhra Pradesh is extended for completing sanctioned houses.  Eligible beneficiaries in Amaravati need coverage under the housing scheme.

news.title: West Bengal mandates wastewater recycle in housing societies
news.para: West Bengal has issued a policy for safe treated wastewater reuse. Residential units must reuse treated wastewater for non-potable purposes. Industrial water needs will see 20% wastewater use by 2030. A GIS platform will manage water demand and wastewater generation. Urban local bodies will develop water resource management plans.

news.title: Andhra Pradesh government unveils building reforms to fast-track urban development
news.para: Andhra Pradesh has introduced significant reforms to its building regulations. Phased fire clearances are now available for high-rise construction projects. Developers can pay infrastructure impact fees in six instalments over three years. Setback norms are now flexible based on plot size and building height. These changes aim to accelerate construction and attract new investments.

news.title: Builders urge West Bengal govt to lift high-rise construction ban as audit deadline ends today
news.para: Kolkata developers want the state government to lift the high-rise construction embargo immediately. They propose continuing safety audits while allowing regulated work to resume at stalled sites. Builders are ready to submit undertakings confirming compliance with all necessary structural and safety requirements. This prolonged stoppage has significantly impacted homebuyers, contractors, and daily-wage workers across the region.

news.title: Innov8 founder buys Golf Links bungalow for ₹85 crore
news.para: Ritesh Malik, Innov8 founder, purchased a bungalow in Delhi's Golf Links for Rs 85 crore. This transaction marks a trend of corporate leaders acquiring upscale properties in the area. India Sotheby's International Realty facilitated this high-value residential deal for both parties. Golf Links has become a preferred destination for entrepreneurs seeking prime locations. Several other prominent figures have also bought properties in this exclusive Delhi neighborhood.

news.title: ED searches Imperia premises in homebuyers’ fraud case; seizes ₹50.50 lakh, luxury vehicles
news.para: The Enforcement Directorate conducted searches and surveys at eight residential and business premises linked to Imperia Wishfield, Imperia Structures, their promoter directors and the resolution professional. The investigation relates to alleged non-delivery of projects, assured-return defaults and diversion of homebuyer funds.

news.title: Over 4.21 lakh beneficiaries registered under PMAY-Urban 2.0 in Maharashtra
news.para: Maharashtra has registered over 4.2 lakh beneficiaries for PM Awas Yojana (Urban) 2.0. Construction for 1.6 lakh houses has been approved under various schemes. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis urged agencies to expedite housing projects statewide. Quality and timely completion of homes remain a key priority. An integrated portal will manage and allocate available housing stock.

news.title: LIC Housing Finance’s net profit rises 10% to ₹1,499.03 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: LIC Housing Finance’s consolidated total income declined 1.4 per cent to ₹7,085.58 crore during the quarter. Total disbursements increased 14.5 per cent year-on-year to ₹15,014 crore.

news.title: Embassy Office Parks REIT’s NOI rises 17% to ₹1,020 crore in Q1 FY27
news.para: Embassy Office Parks REIT’s consolidated total income increased 16.6 per cent to ₹1,260 crore, while net profit rose 25.8 per cent to ₹195.21 crore. Its manager approved a distribution of ₹598.12 crore, or ₹6.31 per unit.

news.title: Lucknow civic body's 5% property tax rebate ends on July 31
news.para: Lucknow Municipal Corporation has said July 31, 2026, will be the last date for property taxpayers to avail a 5% rebate on house tax payments. The rebate is applicable on both online and offline payments.

news.title: Vedanta to demerge real estate business into Vedanta Property Platforms
news.para: Vedanta’s board has approved a draft scheme of arrangement to demerge its real estate business into Vedanta Property Platforms. The surplus real estate portfolio comprises about 2,200 acres of land and about 55,000 sq ft of residential and commercial properties.

news.title: M3M India, Trehan IRIS to invest ₹1,900 crore in Gurugram projects
news.para: M3M India will invest ₹600 crore in a Gurugram commercial development. This project is expected to generate ₹1,500 crore in revenue. Trehan IRIS commits ₹1,300 crore for a Gurugram residential project. The Omara project will offer 320 residences with spacious homes. Both developments are scheduled for completion by the end of 2029.

news.title: Bombay HC grants SEBI time to file affidavits in Embassy REIT matters
news.para: The Bombay High Court on Wednesday granted the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) time to file detailed affidavits in two writ petitions concerning allegations against the Sponsor and promoters of Embassy Office Parks REIT.

news.title: Bihar government to lift curbs on land deals in satellite townships
news.para: Bihar government will lift land sale restrictions in satellite township areas. This move aims to facilitate planned urban expansion and provide relief to landowners. Development plans for these areas are being prioritized for final notification. Land transactions will be permitted under a regulated planning framework after plans are in force. This decision promotes transparent land management and encourages investment in new cities.

news.title: Lucknow: LDA makes fire safety certificates mandatory for building map approval
news.para: Building map approvals in Lucknow now require mandatory fire safety certificates.  Commercial and public-use buildings must submit a valid fire NOC before approval.  Smaller buildings will submit affidavits and undergo audits within three months.  This new rule applies to various establishments like hotels and schools.  The LDA aims to enhance fire safety before construction commences.

news.title: Jaipur development body's new fire NOC rule slows building plan approvals
news.para: Jaipur Development Authority building plan approvals have slowed significantly. A new order mandates Fire No Objection Certificates before final sanction. Architects express confusion and uncertainty regarding the revised approval process. This change follows the implementation of a new fire safety act. Fire officials also question the feasibility of issuing NOCs without inspections.

news.title: Construction waste plant in Gurugram faces heat over approval, tree-felling charges
news.para: Residents near a proposed construction waste plant in Gurgaon reported tree felling.  The Haryana Pollution Control Board has not received any plant proposal.  Local authorities awarded a contract for boundary fencing and a waste dump site.  Residents have filed a complaint seeking an investigation into alleged violations.  Concerns persist regarding health impacts and adherence to environmental laws.
